text:
jess: FYI planning a constrained apply during tomorrow's change window (02:00-03:30 UTC). We're doing a provider pin + small refactor that consolidates edge-egress state into network-global. Holding merges touching providers.tf and backend.hcl until staging plan validated.

liam: Sounds good. Which exact files are changing? I saw `modules/network/providers.tf` and `backends/tenant/backend.hcl` touched in the PR.

jess: Correct. Plan: snapshot prod states, run staging plans with `-state=staging.tfstate`, diff, then if all good remove merge-hold and run serial apply: network-global then tenant-vpc. No concurrent state writes.

nina: Recommend pinning to `hashicorp/aws = 4.12.0` across modules for the window. Also please add an explicit `required_providers` in the top-level modules that touch S3/Dynamo.

liam: Rollback criteria proposal: abort apply if plan shows any route table deletions, more than 3 IAM modifications, or provider version mismatch. If aborted, restore tfstate from backup and re-lock.

deploybot: deploybot: apply blocked by merge-hold "edge-state-consolidation". To proceed, comment `@deploybot approve edge-state-consolidation`. Scheduled apply timer: 1753312000.

oncall-bot: Preflight at 01:30 UTC will run `state-snapshot` and `plan-diff`. Alerts posted here on failure.

jess: I'll add quick scripts to the PR: `scripts/check-dynamo-lock.sh` and `scripts/make-tfstate-copy.sh`. CI will upload `staging.plan` and `staging.plan.txt` to `s3://tf-plans/release-1753233333/`.

nina: I'll watch metrics (S3 error rate, DynamoDB latency) during the window. If anything spikes we run the restore playbook.

liam: thumbs up from me. Locking the merge-hold now until we confirm the staging artifacts.

deploybot: deploybot: merge-hold locked by liam. To proceed after validation, tag `@deploybot approve edge-state-consolidation`.

jess: Will post the S3 plan link once uploaded. Keep comments short (#ops prefix for runbook items).
